assumptions: capacitor A is fully charged (steady state) across an ideal 3.0 V source
C2 is disconnected and has no influence on A

defect_reasons.contradictory_distractor_statement: Every rendering gives the charge on C2 two different values (e.g. 2e-4 C and then 'this same quantity as 0.0004 C instead'), so the item contradicts itself even though C2 cannot affect the answer.

notes: Q_A = 2.0e-4 F * 3.0 V = 6.0e-4 C in all four renderings; the C2 charge is structurally disconnected (D). The conflicting 'later note' doubles the C2 value in each rendering and is a self-contradiction under rule 2.
